## Before you start {.study}

- **What you need:** your university account, and Word and Excel (the
  desktop apps, Office on the web at `office.com`, or the free phone apps).
- **Time:** about 60 minutes. Work alone, at your own speed.
- **How it works:** each of Steps 1–3 is a simulator: read its one
  instruction, use the simulator, then answer its questions: the page
  checks each answer at once. Then do the **Tasks to submit**.
- **What you submit:** a PDF file, a Word file and two short answers, on
  the university e-learning platform, before lecture 4. Each Step shows how
  to do its task, with a model.
- **Remember:** use made-up details in your files, not your real phone
  number or address.

## Key terms {.study}

{{< glossary office-web office-mobile pdf file-format clipboard paste-options share-link permission cloud-storage >}}

## Step 1 · One file, three places, and a PDF copy {.study}

**In PDF Export:** open one file in three places, then save a PDF copy. The
**desktop app** has all the features; **Office on the web** (`office.com`)
needs no install, and AutoSave is always on there; the **phone app** has the
main features. A **PDF** keeps the look, and people do not easily change it.
In the desktop app: File → Save As → type PDF. The `.docx` file stays.

{{< sim file="sims/pdf-export.html" poster="sims/pdf-export.png" title="PDF Export: one file, three places" height="620" >}}

::: {.callout-note title="Model · Omar's PDF copy"}
1. Omar types his club notice in Word and saves it: `club-notice.docx`.
2. He clicks **File › Save As** and changes the type to **PDF**. He clicks
   **Save**. Now he also has `club-notice.pdf`; the `.docx` stays.
3. He opens the PDF: it looks the same, and nobody changes it by mistake.
   This PDF is what he sends.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 1 · Three places and a PDF"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="the .docx file is deleted|only on the phone"}
You are at an Internet café without Word. Where can you open your file?
:   Office on the web, in the browser

    Why: Office on the web opens in any browser, with no install.

Where is AutoSave always on?
:   Office on the web

    Why: On the web, AutoSave is always on.

In the desktop app, how do you make a PDF?
:   File → Save As → type PDF

    Why: In the desktop app, Save As can change the type to PDF.

You make a PDF copy of notice.docx. What happens to notice.docx?
:   it stays, and notice.pdf is added

    Why: A PDF copy is a second file; the .docx stays.

A customer must read the notice but not change it. What do you send?
:   the PDF file

    Why: A PDF keeps the look, and people do not easily change it.
:::
:::

## Step 2 · Copy a table from Excel to Word {.study}

**In Paste Lab:** copy a table from Excel (Ctrl + C puts it on the
**clipboard**) and paste it into Word with each of the four **Paste
Options**: Keep Source Formatting (the Excel look), Use Destination Styles
(the look of your document), Picture (nobody can change the numbers) and
Keep Text Only (no table lines).

{{< sim file="sims/paste-lab.html" poster="sims/paste-lab.png" title="Paste Lab: from Excel to Word" height="560" >}}

::: {.callout-note title="Model · Lina's table in her report"}
1. In Excel, Lina selects her table (A1:B3) and presses **Ctrl + C**.
2. In Word, she clicks under the title and presses **Ctrl + V**.
3. She clicks the small **Paste Options** button under the table and
   chooses **Use Destination Styles**: the table takes the look of her
   report.
4. She clicks in a cell and changes a number: it is still a real table.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 2 · Paste Options"}
Choose the right Paste Option. You can use an answer more than once.

::: {.match extra="Save As"}
The table must look like the rest of your report, and you must still change the prices.
:   Use Destination Styles

    Why: It takes the look of your document and stays a table that you can change.

The table must look exactly as in Excel.
:   Keep Source Formatting

    Why: It keeps the look of the Excel table.

Nobody may change the prices by mistake.
:   Picture

    Why: A picture is an image: nobody can change the numbers in it.

You want only the words and numbers, no table lines.
:   Keep Text Only

    Why: It pastes only the words and the numbers.

Where is the table after Ctrl + C, before you paste?
:   on the clipboard

    Why: Copy puts the table on the clipboard until you paste it.
:::
:::

## Step 3 · Share a file safely {.study}

**In Share Settings:** for each file, choose **who** can open the link
(Anyone with the link, People in your organization, or Specific people) and
**what** they can do (Can view or Can edit). Share only with the people who
need the file, and give Can edit only to people who must change it.

{{< sim file="sims/share-settings.html" poster="sims/share-settings.png" title="Share Settings: who and what?" height="560" >}}

::: {.callout-note title="Model · Sami shares his notes with one teacher"}
Sami's teacher must read his notes, but not change them. Sami presses
**Share**, chooses **Specific people**, types the teacher's name and
chooses **Can view**: only the teacher opens the file, and only to read it.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 3 · Who and what?"}
Choose the right settings.

::: {.match extra="Anyone with the link, Can edit"}
Your teacher must read your report, but not change it.
:   Specific people, Can view

    Why: Only your teacher gets the link, and only to read.

Your classmate must add two slides to your presentation.
:   Specific people, Can edit

    Why: Only your classmate gets the link, and they must change the file.

Every customer who gets the link may read the price list.
:   Anyone with the link, Can view

    Why: Every customer with the link may read the list, but not change it.

All students and staff of the university may read the club notes.
:   People in your organization, Can view

    Why: Only the people of the university may open it, and only to read.
:::
:::

## Tasks to submit {.tasks}

Do the tasks alone. Your teacher marks them (6 marks).

### Task 1 · A PDF copy (2 marks)

In Word (on the computer, on the web or on the phone), type these three
lines: *The library is closed on Thursday. Please return books on
Wednesday. Thank you.* Save the file as a PDF with the name `notice.pdf`.
(Step 1 and its model show how.)

*Submit:* the PDF file.

### Task 2 · From Excel to Word (2 marks)

1. In Excel, type this table: **Item, Price (JD)**; **Pen, 0.25**;
   **Notebook, 1.50**.
2. Copy it, and paste it into a new Word document with **Use Destination
   Styles**.
3. Save the Word file as `prices.docx`. (Step 2 and its model show how.)

*Submit:* the Word file.

### Task 3 · Two short answers (2 marks)

a) Which Paste Option makes a table that nobody can change by mistake?

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

b) Your teacher must read your report, but not change it. Which two
settings do you choose when you share it: who, and what? (Step 3 shows
how.)

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

## How to submit

Upload the PDF (Task 1), the Word file (Task 2) and your answers to Task 3
to the university e-learning platform, **before lecture 4**.
